Compare different numbers of topics

Source: R/topics.R
topic_k_search.Rd

Fits a model for each value of `k` and reports the average topic coherence (UMass; closer to zero means a topic's top words more often appear together). Look for the `k` where coherence is best or stops improving, then read the topics to see whether they make sense. This is a guide, not a verdict.

Usage

topic_k_search(data, k = 2:8, ...)

Arguments

data

A data frame, as for [topic_model()].

k

Vector of topic counts to try.

...

Other arguments passed to [topic_model()] (for example `seed`, `n_iter`, `stopwords`).

Value

A data frame with `k`, `mean_coherence` and `loglik`; it has a `plot()` method.

Examples

f <- system.file("extdata", "sample_abstracts.bib", package = "citelens")
topic_k_search(bib_to_df(f), k = 2:4, n_iter = 200, seed = 1)
#>   k mean_coherence    loglik
#> 1 2      -27.93096 -2973.204
#> 2 3      -25.20248 -2749.025
#> 3 4      -27.23311 -2486.507
